title: Suspicion, Reporting and Responding to Authorities
summary: How to escalate concerns about tax evasion, reach a reasoned judgement on suspicion, report to the national FIU and respond to tax authority and law enforcement requests without tipping off.
contentGaps: Written as part of a programme: Aim and Purpose is the module's one-line description; audience, prior knowledge and core reading come from the programme

sections.Aim and Purpose: How to escalate concerns about tax evasion, reach a reasoned judgement on suspicion, report to the national FIU and respond to tax authority and law enforcement requests without tipping off.
Learning Objectives: Escalate and investigate tax-related concerns consistently
Decide on and file usable suspicious activity reports involving tax crime
Handle information requests and relationship decisions correctly
Syllabus: Internal reporting and whistleblowing on facilitation concerns
Suspicion of tax crime: thresholds, evidence and decision records
Report quality, tipping off and exiting or continuing relationships
Responding to tax authority, FIU and law enforcement requests
Intended Audience: MLROs, compliance officers and tax compliance teams in investment, wealth management and fund management firms
Relationship managers, private client advisers, fund administrators and transfer agency teams
Senior managers accountable for client onboarding, distribution, introducers and tax reporting
sections.Useful Prior Knowledge and Experience: Some experience of compliance, AML/CFT or client onboarding is helpful. No specialist knowledge of tax law is required.
Core Reading: FATF, International Standards on Combating Money Laundering and the Financing of Terrorism and Proliferation: The FATF Recommendations (as updated)
OECD, Fighting Tax Crime – The Ten Global Principles, Second Edition (2021)
OECD, Standard for Automatic Exchange of Financial Account Information in Tax Matters, Second Edition (2017)
OECD, Ending the Shell Game: Cracking down on the Professionals who enable Tax and White Collar Crimes (2021)
